title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival as Earth becomes uninhabitable. Isolation, time dilation, and the bond between a father and daughter drive this science-fiction epic.
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

title: Inception
overview: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O. A mind-bending heist built around nested dreams and unpredictable twists.
tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime with the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent. When the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological tests of his ability to fight injustice.
tagline: Why so serious?

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Framed in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.

title: The Godfather
overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael, steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
tagline: An offer you can't refuse.

title: Schindler's List
overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this wildly inventive crime caper. Intertwining stories of violence, dark humor, and chance.
tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean you have character.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. A feel-good story about kindness, destiny, and an extraordinary ordinary life.
tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.

title: Fight Club
overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground fight clubs forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. A sweeping fantasy adventure about friendship and the burden of power.
tagline: One ring to rule them all.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: Aragorn is revealed as the heir to the ancient kings as the Battle of Helm's Deep is forgotten as the Ringing War begins. A climactic fantasy epic of courage, sacrifice, and hope.
tagline: The eye of the enemy is moving.

title: The Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the powerful computers that now control the earth. A landmark film about simulated reality, artificial intelligence, and free will.
tagline: The fight for the future begins.

title: Star Wars
overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
tagline: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...

title: The Empire Strikes Back
overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke.
tagline: The Adventure Continues...

title: Blade Runner
overview: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.
tagline: Man has made his match... now it's his problem.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. Isolation, identity, and what it means to be human.
tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.

title: Gravity
overview: Dr. Ryan Stone, a brilliant medical engineer on her first Shuttle mission, with veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky in command of his last flight before retirement. But on a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes. Isolation and survival in the vacuum of space.
tagline: Don't let go.

title: The Martian
overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to find a way to survive.
tagline: Bring him home.

title: Donnie Darko
overview: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes. A cult psychological science-fiction film about time, fate, and mental unraveling.
tagline: You can never go home again.

title: The Prestige
overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy — full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences. An unpredictable ending built on scientific ambition and showmanship.
tagline: Are you watching closely?

title: Memento
overview: Leonard Shelby, an insurance investigator, suffers from anterograde amnesia and uses notes and tattoos to hunt for the man he thinks killed his wife. A nonlinear psychological thriller with an unpredictable structure.
tagline: Some memories are best forgotten.

title: Se7en
overview: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the seven deadly sins in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next.
tagline: Seven deadly sins. Seven ways to die.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
overview: Clarice Starling, a young FBI trainee, seeks the advice of imprisoned cannibal Dr. Hannibal Lecter to help catch another serial killer. A tense psychological crime thriller.
tagline: To enter the mind of a killer she must challenge the mind of a madman.

title: The Departed
overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. An intelligent crime thriller of moles, loyalty, and betrayal — not a romance.
tagline: Lies. Betrayal. Sacrifice. How far will you take it?

title: The Usual Suspects
overview: Held in an L.A. interrogation room, Verbal Kint attempts to convince the feds that a mythic crime lord, Keyser Soze, only exists in his imagination. An unpredictable crime thriller built on a famous twist ending.
tagline: The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist.

title: Reservoir Dogs
overview: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime, loyalty, and suspicion without romantic subplot.
tagline: Every dog has his day.

title: The Sixth Sense
overview: A frightened, withdrawn Philadelphia boy who communicates with spirits seeks the help of a disheartened child psychologist. A psychological mystery with an unpredictable ending.
tagline: Not every gift is a blessing.

title: Gone Girl
overview: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent. A psychological thriller about marriage, media, and deception.
tagline: You don't know what you've got 'til it's...

title: Shutter Island
overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions. A psychological thriller with an unpredictable ending.
tagline: Someone is missing.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
overview: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup wants to follow tradition and grow up to become a dragon slayer. A feel-good adventure about friendship, belonging, and seeing beyond fear.
tagline: One adventure will change two worlds.

title: Coco
overview: Despite his family's baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. A heartfelt, feel-good story about family, memory, and following your passion.
tagline: The celebration of a lifetime.

title: Paddington 2
overview: Paddington, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his aunt's birthday, but he ends up being framed for theft. Widely praised as a feel-good film with exceptional storytelling.
tagline: Sometimes it takes a bear to find a home.

title: La La Land
overview: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dive bars. A bittersweet, visually rich love story about art and ambition.
tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.

title: Birdman
overview: A fading actor best known for his portrayal of a superhero attempts to mount a Broadway play. A darkly comic drama about ego, art, and relevance, shot to feel like a continuous take.
tagline: The unexpected virtue of ignorance.

title: Parasite
overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident. A class-conscious thriller-comedy with an unpredictable turn.
tagline: Act like you own the place.

title: Her
overview: In the not so distant future, Theodore, a lonely writer, purchases a newly developed operating system designed to meet the user's every need. A tender science-fiction romance about artificial intelligence, loneliness, and connection.
tagline: A Spike Jonze love story.

title: Ex Machina
overview: Caleb, a 26-year-old coder at the world's largest internet company, wins a competition to spend a week at a retreat belonging to his firm's reclusive CEO. A taut science-fiction thriller about artificial intelligence, consciousness, and manipulation.
tagline: There is nothing more human than the will to survive.

title: Room
overview: Jack is a young boy held captive with his mother, who has been kidnapped and locked in a small room for seven years. A harrowing yet hopeful story of isolation, survival, and love.
tagline: Love knows no boundaries.

title: The Intouchables
overview: A true story of two men who should never have met: a quadriplegic aristocrat who has recently been victim of a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects. A feel-good film about friendship and dignity.
tagline: Sometimes you have to reach into someone else's world to find out what's missing in your own.

title: Life Is Beautiful
overview: A touching story of an Italian book seller of Jewish ancestry who uses his imagination to protect his son from the horrors of internment in a Nazi concentration camp. Hope and storytelling as survival.
tagline: An unforgettable fable that proves love, family and imagination conquer all.

title: 12 Angry Men
overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murder. A nearly perfect chamber drama about reason, prejudice, and reasonable doubt.
tagline: Life is in their hands — death is on their minds.

title: American History X
overview: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Through his brother, we witness the life he led and the path he takes after prison. A hard-hitting drama about hate, family, and change.
tagline: Some men are found in prison. Others are found at home.

title: American Beauty
overview: Lester Burnham, a depressed suburban father in a mid-life crisis, decides to turn his hectic life around after developing an infatuation with his daughter's attractive friend. A darkly comic drama about suburban emptiness.
tagline: Look closer.

title: Whiplash
overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity. Intense storytelling about ambition, mentorship, and obsession.
tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.

title: The Handmaiden
overview: A Korean woman is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, but secretly she is involved in a plot to defraud her. A layered psychological thriller with deception and an unpredictable structure.
tagline: Desperate to escape her gilded cage.

title: Memories of Murder
overview: During the late 1980s, two detectives in a South Korean province attempt to solve the nation's first serial murders. An intelligent crime thriller grounded in procedure, atmosphere, and frustration rather than romance.
tagline: The most stimulating film of the year.

title: Nightcrawler
overview: A driven young man stumbles upon the underground world of freelance crime journalism in Los Angeles. An intelligent character study and crime thriller without a conventional romance.
tagline: The city shines brightest at night.

title: Requiem for a Dream
overview: The hopes and dreams of four ambitious people are shattered when their drug addictions begin spiraling out of control. A harrowing psychological drama.

title: A Beautiful Mind
overview: John Nash, a brilliant but asocial mathematician, accepts secret work in cryptography and is later diagnosed with schizophrenia. A biographical drama about genius, delusion, and love.
tagline: He saw the world in a way no one could have imagined.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
overview: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend underwent a procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. A mind-bending romance about memory, identity, and whether love is worth the pain.
tagline: I already forget how I used to feel about you.

title: Back to the Future
overview: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest. A feel-good adventure-comedy classic.
tagline: He's the only kid ever to get into trouble before he was born.

title: Jurassic Park
overview: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. A landmark adventure-thriller about science, wonder, and survival.
tagline: An adventure 65 million years in the making.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
overview: An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle. After waking from a four-year coma, she sets out for revenge. Stylish action with martial-arts set pieces.
tagline: Revenge is a dish best served cold.

title: Gladiator
overview: In the year 180, the death of emperor Marcus Aurelius throws the Roman Empire into chaos. Maximus, one of the Roman army's most capable and trusted generals, is named heir — then betrayed. An epic of revenge, honor, and spectacle.
tagline: A hero will rise.

title: The Green Mile
overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. A moving drama about justice, cruelty, and grace.
tagline: Miracles do happen.

title: GoodFellas
overview: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who grows up idolizing the local mobsters. An unvarnished crime epic about loyalty, excess, and fallout.
tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.

title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
overview: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon rallies the other patients into rebellion. A landmark drama about freedom and institutional control.
tagline: If he's crazy, what does that make you?

title: Psycho
overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the Bates Motel. A foundational psychological thriller.
tagline: A new—and altogether different—screen excitement.

title: The Shining
overview: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated. Isolation, cabin fever, and psychological horror.
tagline: A masterpiece of modern horror.

title: Alien
overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. Isolation and survival horror in space as the crew encounters a deadly organism.
tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

title: Aliens
overview: When Ripley's lifepod is found by a salvage crew over 50 years later, she finds that terra-formers are on the native inhabited planet. Survival action as colonial marines face a nest of aliens.
tagline: This time it's war.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
overview: Humanity finds a mysterious object buried beneath the lunar surface and sets off to find its origins with the intelligent computer HAL 9000. A landmark meditation on evolution, artificial intelligence, and isolation in space.
tagline: The ultimate trip.

title: WALL·E
overview: WALL·E is the last robot left on an abandoned, polluted Earth. He meets EVE, a sleek probe sent back to evaluate whether Earth can support life again. A largely silent, feel-good science-fiction fable about loneliness and care.
tagline: After 700 years of doing what he was built for, he'll discover what he was meant for.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: A clown fish named Marlin lives in the Great Barrier Reef and loses his son Nemo. A feel-good adventure about parenthood, courage, and the open ocean.
tagline: There are 3.7 trillion fish in the ocean. They're looking for one.

title: Toy Story
overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. A pioneering feel-good animation about jealousy, friendship, and play.
tagline: The adventure takes off!

title: The Lion King
overview: A young lion prince is cast out of his pride by his cruel uncle, who claims he killed his father. While the uncle rules with an iron fist, the prince grows up beyond the Savannah. A feel-good (and tear-jerking) coming-of-age epic.
tagline: Life's greatest adventure is finding your place in the Circle of Life.

title: Paddington
overview: A young Peruvian bear travels to London in search of a home. Finding himself lost and alone at Paddington Station, he meets the kindly Brown family. A gentle feel-good family comedy.
tagline: The adventure begins.

title: The Social Network
overview: On a fall night in 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer programming genius Mark Zuckerberg sits down at his computer and begins working on a new idea. A sharp drama about ambition, friendship, and betrayal in the birth of Facebook.
tagline: You don't get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies.

title: Titanic
overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A sweeping romance set against disaster and class divide.
tagline: Nothing on Earth could come between them.

title: Batman Begins
overview: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City. Origin-story action with a psychological edge.
tagline: Evil fears the knight.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation. Eight years later, a new terrorist leader, Bane, overwhelms Gotham's finest.
tagline: The legend ends.

title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
overview: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet — eradicating the Syndicate, an international rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.
tagline: Desperate times. Desperate measures.

title: Breaking Bad
overview: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to manufacturing and selling methamphetamine with a former student in order to secure his family's future.
tagline: Change the equation.

title: Stranger Things
overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl with telekinetic powers.
tagline: Every ending has a beginning.

title: Game of Thrones
overview: Nine noble families fight for control over the lands of Westeros, while an ancient enemy returns after being dormant for millennia in an epic medieval fantasy saga.
tagline: Winter Is Coming.

title: Chernobyl
overview: A harrowing dramatization of the April 1986 nuclear plant disaster in the Soviet Union, following the courageous men and women who sacrificed themselves to save Europe from disaster.
tagline: What is the cost of lies?

title: Succession
overview: The Roy family is known for controlling the biggest media and entertainment company in the world. However, their world will change when their aging father steps down from the company.
tagline: Make your move.

title: The Last of Us
overview: Twenty years after a fungal outbreak devastates the world, a hardened survivor named Joel is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie across a quarantine zone in a brutal post-apocalyptic journey.
tagline: When you're lost in the darkness, look for the light.

title: Dark
overview: A family saga with a supernatural twist, set in a German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the double lives and fractured relationships among four families across time.
tagline: The question is not where, but when.

title: Black Mirror
overview: An anthology series exploring a twisted, high-tech multiverse where humanity's greatest innovations and darkest instincts collide.
tagline: The future is bright.

title: Arcane
overview: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and incompatible convictions.
tagline: Every legend has a beginning.

title: The Boys
overview: A fun and irreverent take on what happens when superheroes - who are as popular as celebrities - abuse their superpowers rather than use them for good.
tagline: Never meet your heroes.

title: Peaky Blinders
overview: A gangster family epic set in 1900s England, centering on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby.
tagline: Crime pays well.

title: Better Call Saul
overview: The trials and tribulations of criminal lawyer Jimmy McGill in the years leading up to his fateful run-in with Walter White and Jesse Pinkman.
tagline: You know who to call.

title: Severance
overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.
tagline: Please try to enjoy each fact equally.

title: Mindhunter
overview: In the late 1970s, two FBI agents expand criminal science by delving into the psychology of murder and getting uneasily close to all-too-real monsters.
tagline: To catch a killer, you must understand a killer.

title: True Detective
overview: Seasonal anthology series in which police investigations unearth the personal and professional secrets of those involved, both within and outside the law.
tagline: Touch darkness and darkness touches you back.

title: House of the Dragon
overview: An internal succession contest within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.
tagline: Fire will reign.
director: Ryan J. Condal & George R.R. Martin

title: The Bear
overview: A young fine-dining chef comes home to Chicago to run his family's Italian beef sandwich shop after a tragic loss in his family.
tagline: Every second counts.

title: Squid Game
overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits with deadly high stakes.
tagline: 45.6 billion is child's play.

title: Sherlock
overview: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London with cutting-edge observation and deduction.
tagline: A modern day Sherlock Holmes.

title: The Queen's Gambit
overview: Orphaned at the tender age of nine, prodigious introvert Beth Harmon discovers and masters the game of chess in 1960s USA. But child stardom comes at a price.
tagline: Winning is the only move.

title: Money Heist
overview: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose.
tagline: The greatest robbery in history.

title: Shogun
overview: When a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village in feudal Japan, Lord Toranaga discovers secrets that could tip the scales of power.
tagline: Destiny is not chosen. It is claimed.
